description: Find visual-art spectacles worldwide by trip dates, place, type and size. Returns up to `limit` events, soonest first (or nearest first when near_lat/near_lng are given), each with dates, status, place, type, size, description, official website and the event's page on spectacularatlas.com.

confirmed_only.description: Only events whose dates the organizer has published.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code (e.g. JP) or country name.

from.description: Trip start, YYYY-MM-DD: events running on or after this day.

near_lat.description: Latitude of a place to search around.

near_lng.description: Longitude of a place to search around.

query.description: Words in the name, place or description, e.g. 'Harbin', 'Kyoto', 'lantern'.

radius_km.description: Search radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 250).

region.description: One of: East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East and Central Asia, Europe, North America, Latin America and the Caribbean, Africa, Oceania.

sizes.description: Mega: about a million visitors or more or a national flagship; Major: about 200,000 to a million; Notable: smaller.

to.description: Trip end, YYYY-MM-DD: events that have started by this day.

top_picks_only.description: Only the best-known spectacles worth a long trip.

types.description: Types of spectacle: light (Light festivals and light art), lantern (Lanterns), drone (Drone shows), projection (Projection mapping), immersive (Immersive venues), parade (Parades and carnivals), fireworks (Fireworks), ice (Ice and snow), balloon (Balloon festivals), cultural (Cultural festivals).

name: search_events
title: Search spectacles
